name: Catcher Local AI Web Testing
free_limit: MIT-licensed local-first Electron desktop application for natural-language browser end-to-end tests using Playwright; free software with no vendor-imposed test quota or expiry.
watch_out: Bring your own LLM API key or compatible local model; external model inference may cost money. No hosted browser/testing infrastructure is included. Unsigned Windows/macOS installers may trigger operating-system warnings; browser sessions and screenshots can be sent to the configured LLM provider when enabled.
